Netanagri Full Episode:
Sonia Gandhi did not write anything in the book about Ahmed Patel, one of her most trusted leaders. She wrote about Pranab Mukherjee’s desire to become PM, but refrained from writing openly about her relationship with him. She refrained from writing about her differences with P. V. Narasimha Rao, the Bofors scandal, and Quattrocchi.
